messages:
sophie-r: Heads-up — scheduling a short partner workshop tomorrow 11:00am PT to finalize the driver/CUDA/ROCm pinning + hotfix playbook. regression hit a few dedicated customers after CUDA12.2 + driver 535. We need alignment: marketplace listing, partner signoff, canary plan. Who can join?
kevin-w: I can make it. I have the repro from Ashby infra and a minimal repro script. will share logs here after lunch. @maria-le fyi.
maria-le: +1. Please include rollback instructions for marketplace images and a note for Dedicated customers about forced driver pin. propose Wed 00:00-03:00 UTC for hotfix window.
pm-jordan: Need a short blurb for the marketplace release notes and a checklist for SIs. I can draft the blurb if you drop the technical callouts.
eng-partner-liaison: I'll loop in HW partner contacts (NVIDIA rep & ROCm eng contact) and ask for expedited signoff. also confirm which driver builds are signed for marketplace images.
sophie-r: thanks. kevin, can you paste the repro steps + logs? we should make that available for partners so they can triage quickly.
kevin-w: repro steps below:
```
# repro (reduced)
git clone https://repo/internal/repro-cuda-reg
cd repro-cuda-reg
CUDA=12.2 NVIDIA_DRIVER=535.54.03 pytest -k test_kv_cache --maxfail=1 -q
```
logs:
```
E tensorflow: cudnnFindConvolutionForwardAlgorithm returned CUDNN_STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED
runtime error: NCCL init failed on GPU0: cudaErrorIllegalAddress
```
kevin-w: root cause likely interaction between driver 535.x and kernel ABI on our centos builds. ROCm side appears unaffected in our quick run but needs more coverage.
maria-le: Can we add a short pin example for marketplace docs?
sophie-r: yes, something like:
```
# recommended pin example for marketplace images
CUDA: 12.2
NVIDIA_DRIVER: 535.54.03 (pinned)
ROCM: 5.7.0 (if using AMD nodes)
Kernel: RHEL-9.2+ recommended
```
eng-partner-liaison: Partner ask: we should provide a canary plan (5% traffic, 2-hour observation, auto-rollback on latency/regression alerts). I'll draft an SLA note for vendor signoff.
pm-jordan: I'll include the rollback steps in the marketplace blurb: how to pin older driver image, how to request rollback from Dedicated.
sophie-r: Action items:
- kevin: upload repro + full logs to the partner folder (due EOD)
- eng-partner-liaison: request partner signoff + list contact times (due EOD)
- pm-jordan: draft marketplace blurb + rollback steps (due EOD)
- maria: confirm hotfix window Wednesday 00:00-03:00 UTC and canary config
we'll decide on public announcement timing after partner signoff.
kevin-w: uploaded repro + compressed logs: https://internal.storage/repro/2105556789-repro.tar.gz
eng-partner-liaison: pinged the NVIDIA rep and ROCm eng. NVIDIA asked for the kernel config and the core dump, ROCm asked for the container manifest. sending both now.
deploy-bot: deployment-canary job queued: job_id=canary-210555-1, target=5% traffic, monitors=[latency, error_rate, obs_regressions].
maria-le: Sounds good. I'll block the hotfix window in calendars and coordinate on-call rota.
sophie-r: great. meeting invite sent for 11:00am PT. please come with any partner-specific asks. :thumbsup:
kevin-w: will be there, bringing the detailed repro timeline.
pm-jordan: thanks all, I'll have the marketplace blurb draft by EOD and drop here for quick review.
eng-partner-liaison: will follow up once partners confirm signoff or request additional artifacts.
sophie-r: closing loop — if nothing else, see you at 11:00am PT.
